claim_verdicts.basis: The claim states that at 10点 the restoration boat had not completed launch, its manifest was unsigned, and it remained at the quay. The cited evidence (fixture-span-orchard_restoration-5) directly supports the unsigned manifest and the boat remaining at the quay at 10点, and the launch rule (fixture-span-orchard_restoration-4) confirms launch is complete only after both signing and departure, so the claim is consistent with the supplied evidence and requires no review.
